scope: Gu Drag Left only; eight same-order suspended-sway frames. Does not inherit right-direction art approval.
source: Approved Gu right-drag revision-2, frozen in 5d84dde
method: Reverse the existing integer displacement field while preserving every source scanline's pixel order, colors and alpha. No whole-character mirror, no resampling and no new image generation.

selfReview.method: All eight native-scale poses, magnified collar/elbow/cuff/knee/shoe regions on alternating dark/light backgrounds, and adjacent silhouette differences including 8-to-1 were inspected.
selfReview.identity: Hair, face, glasses and neck remain exact Idle pixels at the same position; no mirrored hair part or facial drift.
selfReview.direction: Torso, arms and dangling legs trail to screen right under the fixed neck, consistent with leftward dragging. No alternating ground-contact stride.
selfReview.seams: No obvious detached cuff, elbow, knee, added white edge or new suit color discontinuity observed in the inspected sheets.
selfReview.loop: Eight unique frames; measured adjacent displacement 1-3 px including final-to-first. This is a structural continuity check, not a claim of live mouse/App acceptance.
selfReview.limitation: The base pose is asymmetric, so left and right silhouettes are not exact mirrors. Left-direction motion feel and nape-suspension readability remain for independent user GIF review.
selfReview.dynamicPlayback: NOT_VERIFIED_BY_AGENT; original-speed and slow GIFs supplied to the user. No retry of the previously blocked file-URL browser action.
selfReview.appRuntime: NOT_TESTED; current running App and asset overrides were not modified.
